fusions.name: Herd Through the Pass
fusions.desc: Drives the herd ahead of your wagon through a cone 4 tiles long. It deals 28 damage to everything in it, and when it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Drover's Pebble
fusions.desc: Flicks a pebble from the driver's bench at a target up to 6 tiles away. It deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times that at the far end of its reach, and 10% more for each ally near you (max 30%).

fusions.name: Barn on Wheels
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you and every ally in your party for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Circle the Wagons
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
